01M8C5CBHVW2466B18R6TXQ3RV.description: Husband and wife race head-to-head for 60 km on Ninja H2R superbikes! Collect road coins, then wheelie, drift and boost your way to the finish.

01M8DGET528FN32JR36N3VSED2.title: Brain Test: Tic-Tac-Toe, Memory Match, Math Quiz
01M8DGET528FN32JR36N3VSED2.description: Three brainy mini games with a cheeky pink brain! Beat a clever AI at Tic-Tac-Toe, race the clock in Memory Match and earn stars in Math Quiz

01M7QD9JD3M6DMJ6CBC967X87X.title: Minecraft Skyblock +
01M7QD9JD3M6DMJ6CBC967X87X.description: Mine resources and build structures in this creative voxel sandbox where every block is yours to shape!

01M8AJV0TVVX4Q3BWRJ272GM7E.title: GOTHIC STYLE STUDIO
01M8AJV0TVVX4Q3BWRJ272GM7E.description: Mix 48 Y2K, casual and modern pieces — tops, pants, skirts, dresses, shoes and extras. Tap or drag them on, shuffle looks, and save your faves to your lookbook! 💖

01M8EH9WV0P2SSXDPBYXBTRENX.title: Bike Race With Scary Grandma
01M8EH9WV0P2SSXDPBYXBTRENX.description: Race a teal Ninja through golden dunes, pyramids and oasis roads. Dodge two flyovers, pull stunts and outrun your pursuer to a fresh dhol-synth soundtrack!

01M89WV0C3R6RBHTCCRQJ6QG6B.title: Angry Mummy: Turbo Bike Chase
01M89WV0C3R6RBHTCCRQJ6QG6B.description: Race through snowy Swiss Alps passes as the son’s coral-red Ninja and Angry Mummy’s teal R1 trade chappals, belan swings, and high-speed boosts!

01M8BFQF8PF4FRHK1PZ3W93XKY.description: Swerve through colorful gates, collect matching toothpaste tubes, and dodge hazards to grow your Pepsodent tube. Fill the finish glass for coins across normal, daily, hard, and endless runs!

01M8CYC83K8A8N2DRD0S5VN0WJ.title: Christmas Feast Kitchen
01M8CYC83K8A8N2DRD0S5VN0WJ.description: Prepare a complete traditional Christmas roast dinner step by step—chop, season, baste, mash, and plate in a cozy festive kitchen!

01M88DCEMA192MV1PV5RJDFP8S.title: Carrom Clash
01M88DCEMA192MV1PV5RJDFP8S.description: Flick the striker, sink your coins and the Queen, and outplay your opponent on a classic wooden Carrom board.

01M8EXP606J3Q98Z656R4T78P0.title: TOILET RUSH 3D
01M8EXP606J3Q98Z656R4T78P0.description: Draw glowing paths to get Blue Boy and Pink Girl to their own toilets! Dodge walls, cacti and spiky balls, grab coins, and don't let them bump into each other. 100 levels!

01M8CV0TTYKYF7YR67ZKM3W5JE.title: Glam Glaze Cake Boutique 3D
01M8CV0TTYKYF7YR67ZKM3W5JE.description: Bake, glaze and decorate fabulous 3D mirror-glaze cakes in a glam pink boutique. Slice to reveal the layers!

01M8DXB98JBNAH9JWT240Q3YZ4.title: SPACE X ROCKET LIFT
01M8DXB98JBNAH9JWT240Q3YZ4.description: Drive giant trucks hauling SpaceX-style Falcon rockets up the ramp of a huge cargo jet, fly between five airports, and deliver every rocket to its bay!

01M7Q0CFM6BKXYJCX0MPK8H5RH.description: You and 7 players on bedrock pillars over the void. Every 5 seconds a random item! Bridge over, fight, knock everyone off and be the last one standing.

01M8CNCRJG4MJRFM4FE9509ZJM.title: HARVARD UNIVERSITY
01M8CNCRJG4MJRFM4FE9509ZJM.description: The Black Crow gang has invaded Harvard University! Punch, kick, dodge and unleash special blasts across the campus to survive endless waves and defeat the Gang Boss.

01M8BEMVKTQT5EJ58N45Q0WRGB.title: Pika Pin Rescue
01M8BEMVKTQT5EJ58N45Q0WRGB.description: Pull the golden pins in the right order to wash away snakes, spiders and scorpions, steer lava and water, and collect capture balls for Pikachu!

01M7YPMTW1FWYQSJRPX1DR330Z.description: Suit up as Iron Man, blast robot threats with repulsors and missiles, unleash the Unibeam, and rocket through a sprawling city in an armored hero adventure.

01M8EB6V836P4Q4W1YTH1EFFWW.title: Sheru Bhai Muscle Building 2.0
01M8EB6V836P4Q4W1YTH1EFFWW.description: Pump iron as Sheru Bhai! Out-lift rivals, unleash 🦍 BEAST MODE, KO the champ in the ring and flex for the judges to be crowned king of the gym 👑

01M8725GPPBNGERQY2TMNQ3J5Y.title: DUBAI TOUR WITH DRONE
01M8725GPPBNGERQY2TMNQ3J5Y.description: Grab the on-screen RC controller and fly a quadcopter between the towers of a huge 3D city. Climb, turn, strafe and explore!

01M88RTGCF7DKGJQ8DC1S7TE6A.title: Aqua Love : Couple Adventure Again
01M88RTGCF7DKGJQ8DC1S7TE6A.description: Explore a beautiful water park with your partner in Aqua Love : Couple Adventure Again! Swim, ride water slides, enjoy romantic moments and snap couple selfies.

01M8BR7WM1YDP7RE4YQ1DK93P6.title: World Cup Legends 2
01M8BR7WM1YDP7RE4YQ1DK93P6.description: Take the pitch in World Cup Legends 2! Pick your nation, pass, tackle and shoot your way through a full 3D World Cup tournament.

01M8BQ9E66P47BSWRD01SCJSM3.title: Dino Hatch
01M8BQ9E66P47BSWRD01SCJSM3.description: Hatch a baby dino and run! Swipe lanes, pick the best gates, chomp food for DNA, evolve into bigger dinosaurs and smash the bully bosses across jungle, desert and volcano.

01M8EYR79Q5TX0YCA8JA5T80Z4.title: Glam Soap Cutting ASMR 3D
01M8EYR79Q5TX0YCA8JA5T80Z4.description: Melt, swirl and decorate dreamy 3D soap cakes, then hold to cut 3 perfect slices. Pure satisfying soap cutting ASMR!

01M8DT5DPJ20KS2QPN5K6NZCP8.title: VERITY CITY
01M8DT5DPJ20KS2QPN5K6NZCP8.description: Explore a destructible city, drive vehicles, and experiment with weapons in Open World and Sandbox modes.

01M8E3M64211D4YEP5J3HZ4CGA.description: Drive your royal Indian auto-rickshaw through busy city streets! Pick up passengers, help them board, collect fares, enjoy charming goodbyes and finish endless missions.

01M8DD30HMPTDK3527QX3CYC2D.description: The brainy pink mascot is back! Outsmart the AI at Tic-Tac-Toe, race through cosmic Memory Match and survive a HARD twisty Math Quiz!

01M6QQRPJMTDF0GXSPWT4CAMEK.title: Steal an Egg
01M6QQRPJMTDF0GXSPWT4CAMEK.description: Sneak into chicken territory, swipe rare eggs from nests and sprint home before giant chickens catch you! Upgrade speed, raid deeper zones and collect Secret eggs.

01M8B73QRN9KXRGM03QY2JKXWD.description: Army helicopter rescue in a voxel world: save stranded people, then fly Supply Drop Ops and parachute crates onto bullseye targets for streak combos!

01M89AE2SSRBKB0AHKN45N76CF.description: Pick from five original princesses, personalize their eyes, makeup, hairstyles and outfits, then preview a complete, age-appropriate royal look.

01M7JFKXH9FHQNBRGV8RVQAVE2.title: Draw A Bridge
01M7JFKXH9FHQNBRGV8RVQAVE2.description: Draw bridges to guide your car across gaps and obstacles to the finish flag!

01M8BW9MWE79SDZS5K8BJ568W0.description: 🏎️ Drive a real F1 car in a roaring Grand Prix stadium! Dodge rivals, grab coins, fire nitro, pull 360° stunts & beat the Silver Arrow. Unlock 8 liveries & top the leaderboard! 🏆🔥

01M7TBWEV807PA695DGHD1M4S3.title: NINJA H2R VS CHEETAH

01M875X5GQJXD187M2W3Z2CK1J.description: Dash & Power Ram rivals off icy tracks, launch off bounce pads, and conquer Blizzard Battles & Turbo Ice Sprints! Roll your snowball, build bridges, and claim the crown! ❄️💥

01M851VJ3TVBYG3X9FZB5FT2MX.title: Pizza Mania
01M851VJ3TVBYG3X9FZB5FT2MX.description: Build and manage your own 3D pizza restaurant in Pizza Mania!

01M8EPRR4S4D1CRR4RG70MDQK4.title: Gym with girlfriend 3D
01M8EPRR4S4D1CRR4RG70MDQK4.description: Train in a neon gym with your crush Sabrina! She spots your lifts, then you spot hers — swap sets, cheer her on, get buff and climb the leaderboard. 💪❤

01M8BGSMNX6W98YQ9FHQK8SQZM.title: Desi Delivery Truck Simulator 3D
01M8BGSMNX6W98YQ9FHQK8SQZM.description: Drive a desi delivery truck down an endless Indian highway—deliver cargo on time, refuel at pumps, dodge traffic, and beat the clock!

01M8B3EAW0CDZ2DB81EVJJBS7Y.description: Soar between floating sky islands, ride wind updrafts with your glider, collect Star Shards, and unlock 3 mystical realms!

01M8A1YMS1F3QMGPEM774HHABF.title: WEB MAN CRAZY LOVE STORY
01M8A1YMS1F3QMGPEM774HHABF.description: Swing across Dubai, rescue Aisha, and soar through drifting sky gates in a 3D superhero love-story adventure.

01M7MBAD7QYNSJXXKETP0GHX1C.title: Violet Eclipse Princess

01M837KGP32FV7Y78EAJX4TDBY.title: Lila Dream Girl
01M837KGP32FV7Y78EAJX4TDBY.description: Give Lila a dream makeover and send her to the red carpet!

01M8FA47GAY35AEVJR3VJ00S3H.title: Infinite Build
01M8FA47GAY35AEVJR3VJ00S3H.description: Fly free and build anything! 90+ blocks with no limits, no health, plus one-tap castles, towers, temples and skyscrapers.

01M8EWWMEC8QXCM54KGVE6G04K.title: Instant Noodle Runner 3D
01M8EWWMEC8QXCM54KGVE6G04K.description: Swipe a wobbly train of noodle cups through soup, noodle & topping machines, dodge spiky rollers, and serve hungry customers down a 2X–10X cash runway! 🍜

01M8DDNTEQ1YQEPA68RAH8ATHA.title: My Yummy Fruits
01M8DDNTEQ1YQEPA68RAH8ATHA.description: Paint yummy fruits, then watch them dance!

• Interactive drawing system that converts player strokes into solid, collision-enabled surfaces in real-time.
• Physics-driven character movement featuring unique reactions to environmental hazards like rolling rocks, fire, and shifting platforms.

01M8D8YSCDJJ9WE499EPPPC2VJ.title: Pikachu Christmas Cabin: Pull the Pin
01M8D8YSCDJJ9WE499EPPPC2VJ.description: Pikachu and Eevee are freezing on Christmas Eve! Pull the pins to fix the cabin and decorate the tree, kitchen and snowy yard.

01M8D96G9QWPRV0W8Q6NZXMFPB.title: Fruit Blender Juice Merge 2
01M8D96G9QWPRV0W8Q6NZXMFPB.description: Veggie Merge-style fruit blender: drop fruits, merge, blend to juice, glass fills, drink it

01M5EY26AA87ZSY9XFD4EWWDP7.description: Slam the Omnitrix and go hero in Bellwood! Switch between 10 aliens to fight drones, mutants and Vilgax across 7 story missions in a 3D comic-book city.

01M657G722GCY51VVHNVX3GC32.description: Chop polar bears, grind the meat, grill steaks for the camp — then spin into a whirlwind!

01M70PTQQ9BP3ZS5C86K4J1YBD.description: Charge your cast, fling your bait down the channel and reel in rare fish worth millions!

• Procedural, interactive musical harmonies created by your taps.
• A fully reactive, glowing environment that changes based on your touch.

01M5355XJMD0FRQ2N1ZD3FY40D.title: 41 Ragdoll Executions
01M5355XJMD0FRQ2N1ZD3FY40D.description: Unleash mayhem on a protesting crowd of floppy ragdolls with physics-based weapons in this chaotic 3D sandbox playground!

01M3XXVCGKNC1BR7PR90TTQPET.title: Demolition Derpy
01M3XXVCGKNC1BR7PR90TTQPET.description: Navigate a chaotic arena in a wobbly, physics-driven vehicle to bump into rivals and be the last car standing.

01M7675SHB4GE1JX6N8MCPXBGK.title: Mecha Arm +1
01M7675SHB4GE1JX6N8MCPXBGK.description: Race and climb, collect all differents mecha arms

01KTPEAC926G5Q2A3HMXAFW7WN.description: Swipe to steer your block and claim territory by closing loops—but watch out for enemy trails in this fast 3D arena battle!

01M4K7QKZZ149RT4W64EG9RXJT.title: Slap and steal a car
01M4K7QKZZ149RT4W64EG9RXJT.description: Steal epic cars, slap your rivals, build your dream car dealership, and become the richest player in Slap and Steal a Car!

01M7KQ9RRX4PV5JRDHG93QYT10.title: Throw Food for Animals
01M7KQ9RRX4PV5JRDHG93QYT10.description: Throw food to discover animals, train to reach new habitats, and grow a collection of pets that earn for you.

01M7FZ1Q461M3CWX0DJ6DMR2W4.title: Parking City: Prank Simulator
01M7FZ1Q461M3CWX0DJ6DMR2W4.description: Explore a lively voxel city, pull hilarious poop, water and fake-spider pranks, surprise NPCs, escape angry crowds, drive cars and bikes, fly as a bird, play with a dog, and enjoy a chaotic open world

01M6TFFBQ2MPBHZWT2KH2ZN01M.title: Steal an Egg
01M6TFFBQ2MPBHZWT2KH2ZN01M.description: Sneak. Steal. Hatch. Get fast! Steal eggs from sleeping guardians, outrun them home and hatch rare pets.

01M6NTAWWSANVNP00MVKX6MZYC.description: Leap, climb, dash and smash your way through a fully destructible voxel city. Topple towers, tunnel through blocks, flatten everything.

01M778X10HPA0GP6PGZ3ZG8TR9.description: Sneak up on sleeping dragons, hold to tame them, ride them home to your roost and fly over a giant valley with a World Tree, caves and sky islands.

01M3XBTHHCAQBTZHTHF7H2VA8K.title: Astro Boy
01M3XBTHHCAQBTZHTHF7H2VA8K.description: Play this open world simulator where you explore a lively city, drive cars, fight enemies, and complete missions. Level up your character, customize your style, and take on the 30-floor Battle Tower!

01M6RGPE8ANFGQ002A14XH6M7W.description: Spear fish through the ice, cook and sell them, hire workers, shoo away cheeky polar bears and grow a frozen fishing village into a bustling harbor.

01M84X6S13PYH18JVGRFJHP0PG.title: IGI 1
01M84X6S13PYH18JVGRFJHP0PG.description: Infiltrate the snowbound Alpine Outpost, sabotage its relay, then send patrols chasing a false signal as you escape through the mountain trails.

01M8A023419Z0CJ803NH3ANMXG.description: Become a yellow-black transforming robot and save downtown! Defend your squad, defuse bombs, survive ambushes and smash the Iron Warlord.

01M8DZKK0DZD871E3G6N5R8RFA.description: 3D pinball with a fourth dimension: time. Charge the warp meter, slow time, see ghost echoes, score double!

01M7PBMYTWYY55MB203X3MGMGR.title: Stickman: Obby Race
01M7PBMYTWYY55MB203X3MGMGR.description: Race across 30 colorful 3D obstacle courses! Steer and jump past spinning foam hammers, beat three AI rivals, hit checkpoints, and chase the best finish rank.

01M7JDK0X8NPQTVN8TACZA5TX6.title: Arctic Sniper: Frozen Ridge

Scope in and snipe raiders from frozen cliffs. Topple the watchtower, stop the convoy, then fly north to blow the fuel depot and catch the fleeing snowmobiles!

#Action #Adventure
